impact.text: Performance-fee logic, NAV reporting and integrations relying on share price are wrong.

precondition_sources.text: HypoVault pre-sets totalSupply = 1 000 000 in the constructor while the vault owns zero underlying assets.
Before the first fulfilment, computeNAV() == assetsDeposited, so totalAssets == 1.

intent_sources.text: The vault should start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist.
